profiles.name: Grimlock
speciesTraits: Medium Monstrous Humanoid. +4 Strength, +2 Dexterity, +2 Constitution, −2 Wisdom, −4 Charisma. Land speed 30 ft.
Blindsight (Ex) locates foes within 40 ft. with line of effect. Foes beyond 40 ft. have total concealment. Blindsight does not reveal color or visual detail.
Losing either hearing or smell negates blindsight. With one sense remaining, the grimlock functions as if it had Blind-Fight. Losing both leaves it effectively blinded.
Scent (Ex) detects opponents within 30 ft. under ordinary conditions. Spend a move action to determine the direction. Pinpoint the source within 5 ft.
Immune to gaze attacks, visual effects, and illusions or other attacks that rely on sight. Sound- and scent-based effects can still affect a grimlock.
+10 racial bonus on Hide checks in mountains or underground.

Two racial Hit Dice (2d8) grant BAB +2, base Fortitude +0, Reflex +3, Will +3, and one feat. Racial skill points are 5 × (2 + Intelligence modifier). Racial class skills are Climb, Hide, Listen, and Spot.
Martial Weapon Proficiency (battleaxe) is a racial bonus feat. LA +2, so ECL 4 before class levels. Favored class Barbarian.
Common and Undercommon are automatic. The Grimlock region also grants Terran and lists Abyssal, Elven (drow dialect), Kuo-Toan, and Orc as bonus languages.

npcBuilds.name: Diamond Hand

build.title: Grimlock passage guardian, Barbarian 1
build.difficulty: Provisional CR 2. ECL 5 (2 racial HD, 1 class HD, LA +2).
build.speed: 40 ft. with fast movement; base 30 ft.
traits: Chaotic neutral. Unarmored, Dexterity +2 and natural armor +4. Touch 12, flat-footed 14. BAB +3, grapple +7. Fortitude +5, Reflex +5, Will +3. Improved Initiative adds +4. Fast Movement and illiteracy.
Blindsight (Ex) locates foes within 40 ft. with line of effect. Foes beyond 40 ft. have total concealment. Blindsight does not reveal color or visual detail.
Losing either hearing or smell negates blindsight. With one sense remaining, the grimlock functions as if it had Blind-Fight. Losing both leaves it effectively blinded.
Scent (Ex) detects opponents within 30 ft. under ordinary conditions. Spend a move action to determine the direction. Pinpoint the source within 5 ft.
Immune to gaze attacks, visual effects, and illusions or other attacks that rely on sight. Sound- and scent-based effects can still affect a grimlock.
+10 racial bonus on Hide checks in mountains or underground.
Martial Weapon Proficiency (battleaxe) is the racial bonus feat. Power Attack can trade up to 3 points of melee attack bonus for twice that amount of damage when wielding the battleaxe in two hands.
actions: Battleaxe +7 melee in two hands for 1d8+6 slashing, critical ×3.

Rage 1/day for up to 8 rounds. During rage, AC 14, HP 35 at full health, grapple +9, Fortitude +7, Reflex +5, Will +5, and two-handed battleaxe +9 for 1d8+9. When rage ends, lose the 6 HP from increased Constitution and become fatigued for the rest of the encounter.

If a silence effect takes away hearing, use scent to find the direction of a creature within 30 ft. or pinpoint it within 5 ft. Without blindsight, Blind-Fight allows a reroll of a melee miss chance from concealment when attacking a located creature.
build.tactics: Diamond Hand waits where the passage bends within 40 ft. When a silence spell breaks her blindsight, she backs toward her hunt-bonded companion and uses scent to locate anyone close enough to threaten them.

npcBuilds.motive: Cover the retreat of her hunt-bonded companion.
npcBuilds.hook: Diamond Hand guards the bend that leads to the pack’s water cistern.

npcBuilds.name: Cold Water

build.title: Grimlock fissure tracker, racial Hit Dice only
build.difficulty: Provisional CR 1. ECL 4 (2 racial HD, LA +2).
traits: Neutral. Unarmored, Dexterity +2 and natural armor +4. Touch 12, flat-footed 14. BAB +2, grapple +5. Fortitude +2, Reflex +5, Will +3.
Blindsight (Ex) locates foes within 40 ft. with line of effect. Foes beyond 40 ft. have total concealment. Blindsight does not reveal color or visual detail.
Losing either hearing or smell negates blindsight. With one sense remaining, the grimlock functions as if it had Blind-Fight. Losing both leaves it effectively blinded.
Scent (Ex) detects opponents within 30 ft. under ordinary conditions. Spend a move action to determine the direction. Pinpoint the source within 5 ft.
Immune to gaze attacks, visual effects, and illusions or other attacks that rely on sight. Sound- and scent-based effects can still affect a grimlock.
+10 racial bonus on Hide checks in mountains or underground.
Track is the chosen racial Hit Die feat. Martial Weapon Proficiency (battleaxe) is the racial bonus feat.
actions: Battleaxe +5 melee in two hands for 1d8+4 slashing, critical ×3.
Use Track with scent to follow a fresh trail. Roll Survival +0 against a typical DC of 10. Travel at half speed while tracking unless taking the penalty for moving faster.
build.tactics: Cold Water follows a fresh scent trail up the fissure. At the fork, he uses a move action to determine a nearby scent’s direction. If an overpowering odor spoils the trail, he falls back to familiar ground.

npcBuilds.motive: Find a missing climber before the culvert floods.
npcBuilds.hook: Cold Water catches a fresh scent at the foot of the fissure.
